purpose: Display-only retained original observations; no score recomputation or selection on a transform.
linear_rule: constant, or all one sign and max(abs(endpoint))/min(abs(endpoint))<=4
L_definition: Sort nonzero absolute original observations; select floor(0.25*(n-1)); finite zeros remain in every full-range plot.
full_domain: actual original extrema; every numeric observation painted once including overlaps; invalid/outside point is error
ticks: 5 evenly spaced transformed positions with inverse in original units; constant has1; generation ticks are original integer coordinates
detail_membership: higher-is-better Q90 through actual finite MAX; lower-is-better actual finite MIN through Q10; preserve every cutoff and extremum tie in original score units
detail_constant_domain: membership and display bounds remain the exact constant value; coincident points are centered; no widened selection
detail_accounting: strict below/inside/above conserved against original numeric universe; higher strict-above=0, lower strict-below=0; bind selected ordered identities/original score bits and all extremum ties
quantile_definition: sort original numeric observations; floor(p*(n-1)); all values equal to boundary are inside
tail_counts: strictly below, inclusive inside, strictly above; sum equals full original count
leader_direction: argmax for original higher-is-better fitness, argmin for original lower-is-better screen deficit; all exact ties retained
